canonical_prng.field_encoding: u8 tag || u32be byte_length || value bytes; no count, omission, padding, or terminator
canonical_prng.word_hex: exactly 16 lower-case hexadecimal characters for first eight digest bytes in big-endian order
canonical_prng.query_index: zero-based accepted-query index; null for rejected draws

matrix_domain.shard_rule: ordinal in the sorted complete key list modulo 4

rejected_fixtures.reason: total is outside the phase-key sum and is replay-checked
the matrix is the exact 400-key domain

rejected_fixtures.mutation: remove one of the 100 keys from a shard
rejected_fixtures.reason: each shard owns exactly 100 keys and the union is the complete domain

rejected_fixtures.mutation: change one matrix terminal count without changing arm states
select any of the three historical predecessor IDs as the future contract or dependency

semantic_checks: exact six-hex RUN and MATRIX identifier patterns
exact p and rational-b domain and A/B/D seed/replica constraints
required source_blobs keys and lower-case SHA-256 values
phase total equals the sum of exactly seven phase keys
event ledger event_index is contiguous and exception normalization is exact
candidate, relation, query, table, and E.add conservation equations
400 unique complete arm keys and exact 40/40/320 arm counts
exactly four unique shards with 100-key disjoint coverage
terminal totals equal arm states and declared=attempted+not_attempted
campaign wall/CPU/RSS/output equations and all caps
three-record predecessor exclusion is hash-matched and selected/dependency-free
